blocks.x: Operators monetize networks that already know everything: telemetry into predictive ops, experience data into churn saves, energy telemetry into cost control, and edge assets into compute products. The intelligence layer is the strategy.

The workflows we industrialize here: Network operations (NOC), Retention/save offers, Field workforce dispatch, Energy management, Wholesale settlement. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Element alarms flood; correlation manual; customer-impacting events found by tickets.

SIM/eSIM/core keys face PQ exposure; inventory unknown.
IVR containment metric masks unresolved contacts; cost and CSAT both worse.
